manual.godofthings.creative_energy_cube:
What: Creative Energy Cube -- an infinite FE source; all six faces output at maximum rate (infinite FE/t).
Obtain: creative tab.
Use: right-click for a GUI that charges you or your items.
manual.godofthings.creature_annihilation:
What: Creature Annihilation -- while placed, natural mob spawning is blocked within a 512-block radius.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: just place it in your base; no GUI.
manual.godofthings.god_absorber:
What: God Absorber -- absorbs item drops and XP over a large area.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: GUI for on/off, range (0-1600), stored-XP panel and per-face config; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_accelerator:
What: parallel accelerator -- goes into a God machine's accelerator slot; each one multiplies parallel jobs by 16 (a stack of 64 = x1024).
Obtain: crafting / creative tab.
Use: open the machine GUI and put it in the accelerator slot. Affects miner, resource, drop machines, etc.
manual.godofthings.god_backpack:
What: God Backpack -- a **120-slot** portable storage; right-click to open (contents travel with the item, and are kept even if it is dropped).
Obtain: 4 leather + 4 netherite ingots + 1 shulker box.
GUI:
· **Sort**: reorders by the current key (**By Name / By Mod / By Count / By Tags**; click the small button to cycle).
· **Memory**: click Memory to enter marking mode, then click slots to remember their item; memory slots are **never sorted**, **receive matching items first** when storing, and show a faded ghost when empty.
· **No Sort**: click No Sort, then click slots that should **stay put when sorting** (handy for tools).
· **Search**: filters as you type; non-matching slots look empty; start with `@` to search by mod (e.g. `@minecraft`).
· **Store All / Take All**: move everything between your inventory and the backpack.
· **Ignore Durability / Ignore NBT**: relaxes stacking and matching to the item itself.
· **Mouse wheel** scrolls (9 columns x 6 visible rows, 120 slots in total).
· **Keybind**: press `B` to open it (works whether it is in your inventory or equipped in an accessory slot; rebindable in Options - Controls).
· **Accessories**: it can be equipped in the **Curios back slot** and still opened with `B`.
manual.godofthings.god_binder:
What: binds a machine to the God Transmitter's wireless charging network.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click a machine to bind it; holding it in the off hand auto-binds machines you place. Can go into the Tool Belt (ToolBelt mod) for quick swapping: the mod auto-injects these five items into ToolBelt's whitelist (v5.15.8) -- no config edits needed in any modpack.
manual.godofthings.god_black_box:
What: pickup filter storage -- whitelist or blacklist mode, no stack limit inside.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the filter GUI; scroll while holding it to toggle quickly. Can go into the Tool Belt (ToolBelt mod) for quick swapping: the mod auto-injects these five items into ToolBelt's whitelist (v5.15.8) -- no config edits needed in any modpack.
manual.godofthings.god_boots:
What: God Boots -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_change:
What: time / weather control.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click to open the GUI and pick the time and weather to switch to. Can go into the Tool Belt (ToolBelt mod) for quick swapping: the mod auto-injects these five items into ToolBelt's whitelist (v5.15.8) -- no config edits needed in any modpack.
manual.godofthings.god_chestplate:
What: God Chestplate -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_craft:
What: God Craft -- an advanced crafting table with a config menu, 8 template slots and even-input distribution.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the GUI; templates save/reapply your common recipes. Can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_devourer:
What: God Devourer -- a void trash can.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click the block for its GUI; there is also a quick button in the player inventory. **Contents are destroyed when you close the GUI.**
manual.godofthings.god_drop:
What: God Drop -- item collector plus spawn-egg producer. Eggs are not consumed; it rolls the **vanilla loot table** and outputs every drop (e.g. chicken = feather + raw chicken, 64 of each), filtering out weapons/tools/armor so it is not a free-gear machine.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: **since v5.7.0 every mod's spawn egg works** (not just vanilla); put spawn eggs in the input slots (up to 9 in parallel); God Accelerator raises parallelism; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_enchant:
What: God Enchant -- pick any enchantment at any level for any item, no conditions, no lapis, up to level 255 (beyond vanilla); selecting an enchantment defaults to 255.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: put an item -> pick an enchantment -> adjust level -> apply; "Batch" applies it at level 255 to every compatible item in your inventory (incompatible ones are skipped).
manual.godofthings.god_furnace:
What: God Furnace -- a super furnace with JEI / EMI recipe lookup.
Obtain: crafting (this is the root advancement of the mod).
Use: right-click for the GUI and insert your input; since v5.15.5 it can join an AE2 network as a grid node (cable connection, one channel, smelting output auto-pushes into the network, toggle with the AE button at the top right).
manual.godofthings.god_helmet:
What: God Helmet -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: with the full set, press O for feature toggles and K for the skill tree (see System - God Armor & Skills).
manual.godofthings.god_invite:
What: God Invite -- gives a mob infinite health.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click a mob; hit feedback is preserved and can be toggled. Can go into the Tool Belt (ToolBelt mod) for quick swapping: the mod auto-injects these five items into ToolBelt's whitelist (v5.15.8) -- no config edits needed in any modpack.
manual.godofthings.god_leggings:
What: God Leggings -- one of the four God Armor pieces.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: wear all four pieces to activate set features.
manual.godofthings.god_manual:
What: the in-game manual -- every item/block has an entry, look things up here.
Obtain: 1 book + 4 gold ingots.
Use: right-click it, press P, or run /godofthings manual. Pick a tab and entry on the left; search on top.
manual.godofthings.god_measure:
What: God Measurement -- a tape measure. **Right-click a block** to set the start, right-click again elsewhere to set the end: a wireframe box is drawn showing the X / Y / Z dimensions (keep clicking to start the next box). **Sneak-right-click** undoes the last box; **switching held item / dimension / relogging** clears them all. Measuring is client-side only, zero server cost.
Obtain: crafting (gray wool / iron ingot / yellow wool).
Use: line color / text color / text size / line width can be tuned in the [measurement] section of config/godofthings-client.toml. Can go into the Tool Belt (ToolBelt mod) for quick swapping: the mod auto-injects these five items into ToolBelt's whitelist (v5.15.8) -- no config edits needed in any modpack.
manual.godofthings.god_miner:
What: God Miner -- area mining machine with adjustable efficiency/fortune/silk touch and six configurable faces (input pulls in accelerators, output pushes items and fluids). It also works as a pickaxe.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for parameters and face config; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_note:
What: God Note -- a checklist with checkboxes that supports **sub-tasks** (a main task with sub-tasks, like a heading and subheadings).
Obtain: 3 paper + 1 ink sac + 1 gold ingot.
Use: right-click or press N. Up to 8 books per shelf; drag rows to reorder within the same level; the **+ at the end of a row adds a sub-task and Enter keeps the mode so you can add several**; while editing text, Tab demotes it under the previous task and Shift+Tab promotes it; the **triangle at the start of a row folds / unfolds its sub-tasks**; every delete asks twice. Press M to place the overlay. Content is stored per player in the world save.
manual.godofthings.god_slaughter:
What: God Slaughter -- area killing (on/off, range 0-1600, looting 0-1600, instant kill).
Obtain: crafting.
Use: GUI for the settings; drops go straight into its own 27-slot infinite storage. Can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_spawn_egg:
What: God Spawn Egg -- a spawn-egg duplicator. Put a spawn egg in and it produces the **same** egg; **works with every kind of spawn egg** (vanilla, NeoForge, and modded eggs that follow the vanilla convention of storing the entity data in the item). The whole item stack is copied, data included.
Obtain: 8 emeralds + 1 egg.
Use: right-click for the GUI, put spawn eggs into the 3x3 input slots (up to 9 in parallel; input is not consumed); God Accelerators raise the parallel multiplier; output is pushed downward; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_transmitter:
What: God Transmitter -- wireless FE charging for machines and players, working across dimensions.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click for the four-tab GUI; bind machines with the God Binding.
manual.godofthings.god_unbreakable:
What: makes an item unbreakable -- this is a special crafting recipe, not a usable item.
Obtain: look up the recipe in JEI / EMI (craft the item together with God Unbreakable).
Use: combine with the target item; you get the same item with the unbreakable property.
manual.godofthings.hoyoog_fumo:
What: skin plushie -- a full 12-part player model using the standard 64x64 skin UV; texture is the mod author's own skin.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: right-click to toggle its self-rotation (~6 degrees per tick).
manual.godofthings.space_time_eternity:
What: Space Time Eternity -- while placed it locks world time and weather.
Obtain: crafting.
Use: just place it; no GUI.
manual.godofthings.system.ae2:
Nine production machines (miner / resource / drop / **spawn egg** / slaughter / craft / absorber / **furnace** / **peeler**, added in v5.15.5 / v5.15.9) can act as AE grid nodes: just connect a cable (one channel) and their output goes into the network. Each GUI has an AE toggle that only controls pushing output into AE.
Note: **AE2 is required** for this mod to start (those block entities implement AE2 interfaces directly); mods.toml declares it as required.
manual.godofthings.system.ae2.title: AE2 integration
manual.godofthings.system.armor_and_skil:
Wear all four pieces (helmet / chestplate / leggings / boots), then press **K** or **O** for a screen with **three pages** (it remembers the last one; switch with the tabs or `Tab`):
· **God Boosts (7 toggles)**: God Drops / God Mobs / God Blocks / God XP / God Spawn Eggs / God Heads / God Smelting -- turning one on grants its max level; turning it off remembers the level.
· **God Resonance (7 toggles, off by default)**: lets the matching God-series machine inherit the boost above; the machine benefits only while its owner is **online**, wears the **full set**, and the matching resonance toggle is on.
· **God Armor (8 toggles)**: God Flight / Invincibility / Saturation / Fire Resistance / Breathing / Vision / See-Through / Gluttony.
· **Always on (no toggle)**: Village Hero -- active whenever the full set is worn.
· Rows show only on / off; hover for details. Each page has Turn-all-on / Turn-all-off; levels are saved per player.
manual.godofthings.system.compat:
· Optional integrations: JEI / EMI, Jade, AE2 and its addons (AE2WTLib / ExtendedAE / AppliedFlux / AppMek), Ad Astra, Occultism, Malum, Mystical Agriculture, Goety, Iron's Spells, Ars Nouveau, EnderIO, Mekanism, Productive Bees, Construction Wand, GTCEu. Missing ones are skipped automatically.
· Since v5.9.0 the **wireless logistics were removed entirely**, together with the integrations that only served it (Modern Industrialization energy bridge / Mekanism chemical bridge / FTB Teams ownership / Ars source endpoints).
· Note: the dimensions and the plushie are verbatim ports; with useless_mod / ae2lt installed some of our mixins get overridden -- /godofthings doctor names them. This is intended (upstream updates keep being ported).
manual.godofthings.system.compat.title: Compatibility
manual.godofthings.system.dimensions:
· Void Dimension: enter and leave with the Void Teleporter block.
· Useless Dimensions (ported from useless_mod): odd / even / useless, each with its own teleport block.
· Place a teleport block and walk in. The blocks need a pickaxe (they are in the mineable/pickaxe tag).
manual.godofthings.system.faq:
· Machine idle? Check its GUI toggles and range, whether accelerators are inserted, and the six-face I/O config.
· Cannot find something? Use the search box on top of this manual; it searches names and body text.
· Want to know which mods are active, whether our mixins are overridden, or how big the saved data is? Run /godofthings doctor.
· Backups: /godofthings export note and export points (files in <world>/godofthings/exports/).
· Something unclear or missing here? Tell the author, or check the README content table.
manual.godofthings.system.faq.title: FAQ
manual.godofthings.system.getting_starte:
1. Craft the God Furnace first -- it is the root advancement and most materials come from it.
2. Add the God Miner plus God Accelerators: the miner digs, accelerators multiply parallel jobs (x16 each).
3. Missing materials? Use the God Resource (duplication) or God Drop (spawn egg -> vanilla loot table) machine.
4. For convenience: God Note (press N) and this manual (press P).
5. All recipes are in JEI / EMI; this manual only explains what things do.
manual.godofthings.system.keys_and_comma:
[Keys] P manual / N note / M place the note overlay / U waypoints / O armor features / K god boosts.
[Commands] /godofthings doctor, export|import note|points, manual.
Every key can be rebound in Options - Controls - God of Things. (The old tool/staff keys and the /godnote, /setpoint, /point, /delpoint commands were removed by request.)
manual.godofthings.system.note:
A checklist with checkboxes, two levels deep: main tasks and sub-tasks. Two ways in: press N or right-click the item.
· Up to 8 books per shelf; the bar on top switches / creates / deletes (delete needs two clicks).
· Drag a row to reorder **within its level** (main tasks among main tasks, sub-tasks within their parent).
· Sub-tasks: click the **+** at the end of a main-task row -- Enter keeps the mode so you can add several; press **Tab** while editing a task's text to demote it under the previous task (Shift+Tab promotes it back).
· The **triangle at the start of a row folds / unfolds sub-tasks** (the overlay follows it too); a main task with sub-tasks shows an (n/m) progress hint.
· Every delete asks twice; deleting a main task removes its sub-tasks as well.
· Overlay: toggle and adjust on the overlay page, or press M to drag it on screen (it snaps to edges).
· The title is customizable; with auto-rename on it follows the current date (e.g. 10.02).
· Content is stored per player; back up with /godofthings export|import note (import auto-backs up first).
manual.godofthings.system.note.title: God Note
manual.godofthings.system.waypoints:
· Press **U** for the GUI: edit / delete (two clicks) / pin to top; data is stored per player.
· Since v5.9.0 the /setpoint, /point and /delpoint commands were removed by request -- waypoints are handled through the U-key screen only.
· /godofthings export|import points backs them up under <world>/godofthings/exports/.

manual.godofthings.god_ore_machine:
God Ore Machine -- accepts ores only: raw ores / ingots / gems and every ore block (including modded ores like GTCEu). Produces ingots / drops per the ore loot table, 64 per cycle.
Craft: 8 diamond blocks + nether star.
Usage: put ores in the input slots; God Accelerators add parallelism; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_crop_machine:
God Crop Machine -- accepts crops and plants only: seeds / crops / saplings / kelp / sugar cane / cactus / berries / nether wart and every modded plant. Produces per vanilla harvest loot or duplicates, 64 per cycle.
Craft: 8 hay bales + nether star.
Usage: put crops or saplings in the input slots; God Accelerators add parallelism; can join an AE2 network.
manual.godofthings.god_duplicate_machine:
God Duplicate -- accepts everything: any item from vanilla or any mod can be duplicated, 64 per cycle (fast-list blocks and AE2 sky stone every tick, everything else every 20 ticks).
Craft: 8 quartz blocks + nether star.
Usage: put any item in the input slots; God Accelerators add parallelism; can join an AE2 network. Outputs are fresh stacks and do not carry the input's enchantments / durability / container contents.
manual.godofthings.infinity_water_cell:
What: ME Infinity Water Cell -- put it in an ME drive and the network always holds 2.147 billion mB of water for unlimited access (costs no bytes, stores no real data, survives drive removal). Idle drain 8 AE/t.
Obtain: crafting (quartz glass + water bucket + 16k cell part + diamonds).
Use: insert into an ME drive; pair with patterns for free infinite water.
manual.godofthings.infinity_lava_cell:
What: ME Infinity Lava Cell -- put it in an ME drive and the network always holds 2.147 billion mB of lava for unlimited access (costs no bytes, stores no real data). Idle drain 8 AE/t.
Obtain: crafting (quartz glass + lava bucket + 16k cell part + diamonds).
Use: insert into an ME drive; pair with patterns for free infinite lava/fuel.
manual.godofthings.infinity_cobblestone_:
What: ME Infinity Cobblestone Cell -- put it in an ME drive and the network always holds 2.147 billion cobblestone for unlimited access (costs no bytes, stores no real data). Idle drain 8 AE/t.
Obtain: crafting (quartz glass + water bucket + lava bucket + 16k cell part + diamonds).
Use: insert into an ME drive; pair with patterns for free infinite cobblestone.
manual.godofthings.infinity_blank_patter:
What: ME Infinity Blank Pattern Cell -- the network always holds 2.147 billion blank patterns for unlimited access (costs no bytes, stores no real data). Idle drain 8 AE/t.
Obtain: crafting (quartz glass + blank pattern + 16k cell part + diamonds).
Use: insert into an ME drive; pattern providers never run out of blank patterns again.
manual.godofthings.god_peeler:
What: God Peeler -- an auto-stripping machine: logs in, matching stripped logs out. Every vanilla log / wood / stem / hyphae / bamboo block works; modded logs are recognized automatically when they follow the usual stripped_ naming convention (already-stripped logs are not accepted).
Obtain: crafting (8 any logs + nether star).
Usage: put logs into the 3x3 input slots (9 slots, same layout as the God Furnace) and take stripped logs from the matching output slots. Hoppers / pipes work per **face config**: the gear button at the top-right opens the face config, where each of the six faces can be None / Input / Output / Both (all default to None -- configure a face before hoppers can interact); input faces auto-pull logs from adjacent containers, output faces auto-push results to them. Every 5 ticks each input slot strips 1 log -- 9 slots in parallel; God Accelerators raise parallelism and slot capacity (x16 each, a full stack of 64 = x1024). Interval configurable in the [peeler] section of godofthings-machines.toml. Since v5.15.9 it can join an AE2 network as a grid node (cable connection, one channel; stripped logs auto-push into the network; toggle with the AE button on the right).
